title: The Real Reason You Nod When Others Speak
hook: You often nod subtly, even when you do not mean to.

narration.text: You often nod subtly, even when you do not mean to.
This is an unconscious social cue, a signal of engagement.
Your brain performs this automatic mirroring behaviour.
It shows the speaker you are actively listening.
This encourages them to keep talking to you.
Next time, notice yourself doing it during a conversation.
Tell us if you noticed this in yourself, like this if it surprised you, subscribe for more insights, and send this to someone who always does this.

description: Have you ever wondered why you nod or make small affirmative sounds when someone is speaking? It is an unconscious social cue that shows engagement. This subtle behaviour encourages the speaker and strengthens connection.
topic: Why you often find yourself subtly nodding or making small affirmative sounds when someone is speaking. This is an unconscious social cue to show engagement.
